## Recall · Lecture 1

a) Which job does a chime with a flash for a collected coin do?
b) Which element of the tetrad are the events of a game?
c) Which job does a glowing door at the end of a dark room do?

::: {.answer}
a) feedback
b) story
c) guidance
:::

## Activity 1 · Your inventory · 12 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- An inventory lists all the media of a game by channel.
- The five channels are visual, audio, text and story, cinematic and interface.
- **Do it:** Take a screenshot of a busy moment of your game, and list six elements with their channel and their moment.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/annotated-screen.png)
:::
::::

## Check 1 · Your inventory

What does a good inventory look like?

::: {.reveal}
1. It has six rows or more, for example the hero in a cartoon style, the battle music and the health bar.
2. Each row names its channel, for example visual, audio or interface.
3. Each row says when the element appears, for example "always" or "in fights".
:::

## Activity 2 · Three sentences · 10 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- An analysis names the element, its job and its effect on the player.
- One element often has several jobs.
- **Do it:** Choose three elements of your inventory. Write the job and the effect of each one.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/media-functions.png)
:::
::::

## Check 2 · Three sentences

What does a good analytic sentence say?

::: {.reveal}
1. It names one element, for example the red flash when the hero is hit.
2. It names the job: feedback.
3. It says the effect: "I see at once that I lost health, so I play more carefully."
:::

## Activity 3 · Sound Stage · 10 min

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- A diegetic element belongs to the game world, so a character could notice it.
- A non-diegetic element is only for the player.
- **Do it:** Walk the fox past the campfire in Sound Stage. Which elements could the fox notice, and which only the player?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/diegesis.png)
:::
::::

## Live demo · Sound Stage

{{< sim file="sims/sound-stage.html" poster="sims/sound-stage.png" title="Sound Stage: inside or outside the world?" kind="game" task="**Show:** walk the fox past the campfire, then switch the music and the wind off and on. **Ask:** which sounds could the fox hear?" >}}

## Check 3 · Sound Stage

Which elements are inside the game world?

::: {.reveal}
1. The footsteps, the crackle of the fire and the wind are diegetic, because the fox could hear them.
2. The flute music, the health bar and the name tag are non-diegetic.
3. The wind never changes, but it is still diegetic, because the fox could hear it.
:::

## Wrap-up

- You can list the media of a game by channel.
- You can explain the job of an element and its effect on the player.
- You can decide whether an element is inside or outside the game world.
